## D — Accuracy and evidence notes: Revocation, suspension and driver improvement
Every knowledge statement for Revocation, suspension and driver improvement is tied to one physical page of the registered Delaware handbook snapshot. No outside legal explanation or inferred exception is added.
Mandatory-revocation and suspension lists continue headings from the preceding page; the operative listed grounds are on the cited pages. Each may-versus-mandatory distinction is preserved. Historical crash percentages and contact/provider listings are excluded.
One speeding point row has an ambiguous extracted upper bound and is held as typed debt; adjacent unambiguous rows are retained.
Open source limitation (verify DE-PRIVILEGES-RANGE): The point table upper bound printed as 15-l9 requires text/visual clarification before asserting that interval.
Source quality: official issuer PDF. Extraction is text only; graphical content does not become a fact unless its supporting meaning is stated in the text. Unknown exam metadata and market evidence remain typed debt.
